node.title: Re^3: Baffled by DateTime
node.author: BernieC
node.doctext: A small followon. With: perl -E "use DateTime ;my $now = DateTime->now(time_zone => \"EST5EDT\") ; my $day = $now->local_day_of_week ; say \"day of the week: $day\" ; " --------------------- day of the week: 6 The docs say: "Returns the day of the week as a number, from 1..7, with 1 being Monday and 7 being Sunday." But today is Friday...looks like it is "with 1 being Sunday" This is not a big deal, but am I missing something?
